#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
constexpr int MAX_N = 510;
int n, m, MOD;
ll C[MAX_N][MAX_N], F[MAX_N], G[MAX_N];
ll DP1[MAX_N][MAX_N], W1[MAX_N][MAX_N];
ll DP2[MAX_N][MAX_N], W2[MAX_N][MAX_N];
ll DP0[MAX_N][MAX_N], W0[MAX_N][MAX_N];

inline void modAdd(ll &a, ll b) {
    a = (a + b) % MOD;
}

inline ll tri(ll x) {
    return (x * (x - 1) / 2) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> m >> MOD;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) C[i][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    F[0] = 0; G[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            ll t1 = C[i-1][j-1] * F[j-1] % MOD * G[i-j] % MOD * (i+1) % MOD;
            ll t2 = C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1] % MOD * F[i-j] % MOD * (i+1) % MOD;
            ll t3 = C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1] % MOD * G[i-j] % MOD * ((tri(j) + tri(i-j+1)) % MOD) % MOD;
            modAdd(F[i], t1 + t2 + t3);
            modAdd(G[i], C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1] % MOD * G[i-j] % MOD * (i+1) % MOD);
        }
    }
    
    DP1[0][0] = 0; W1[0][0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        memset(DP2, 0, sizeof(DP2));
        memset(W2, 0, sizeof(W2));
        for (int j = 0; j <= min(i, m); ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= min(j, m); ++k) {
                if (k == 0) {
                    DP0[i][j] = DP1[j][0];
                    W0[i][j] = W1[j][0];
                }
                modAdd(DP2[j][0], DP1[j][k]);
                modAdd(W2[j][0], W1[j][k]);
                int rem = m - (j - k);
                ll comb = C[rem][k+1];
                ll baseG = G[k+1];
                ll baseF = F[k+1];
                ll coef = W0[i-k][j-k] * comb % MOD;
                modAdd(W2[j+1][k+1], coef * baseG % MOD);
                modAdd(DP2[j+1][k+1], DP0[i-k][j-k] * coef % MOD + W0[i-k][j-k] * comb % MOD * baseF % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < MAX_N; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < MAX_N; ++k) {
                DP1[j][k] = DP2[j][k];
                W1[j][k] = W2[j][k];
            }
        }
    }
    
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
        modAdd(ans, DP1[m][i]);
    }
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}

        }
    }

llong dp_tmp[MX][MX], ways_tmp[MX][MX];

inline void plusmod(llong &x, llong y) {
    x = (x + y) % modulus;

inline llong triangular(llong x) {
    return x * (x - 1) / 2 % modulus;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);

            comb[i][j] = (comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j]) % modulus;
        }
    }

    funcF[0] = 0; funcG[0] = 1;
    for (int lvl = 1; lvl <= total_m; ++lvl) {
        for (int seg = 1; seg <= lvl; ++seg) {
            llong base = comb[lvl-1][seg-1];
            llong contribution = base * funcF[seg-1] % modulus * funcG[lvl-seg] % modulus * (lvl+1) % modulus;
            contribution = (contribution + base * funcG[seg-1] % modulus * funcF[lvl-seg] % modulus * (lvl+1) % modulus) % modulus;
            contribution = (contribution + base * funcG[seg-1] % modulus * funcG[lvl-seg] % modulus * (triangular(seg) + triangular(lvl-seg+1)) % modulus) % modulus;
            plusmod(funcF[lvl], contribution);
            plusmod(funcG[lvl], base * funcG[seg-1] % modulus * funcG[lvl-seg] % modulus * (lvl+1) % modulus);
        }
    }

    dp_memo[0][0] = 0;
    ways_memo[0][0] = 1;

    for (int step = 0; step < total_n; ++step) {
        memset(dp_tmp, 0, sizeof(dp_tmp));
        memset(ways_tmp, 0, sizeof(ways_tmp));
        for (int j = 0; j <= min(step, total_m); ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= min(j, total_m); ++k) {
                if (k == 0) {
                    dp_shift[step][j] = dp_memo[j][0];
                    ways_shift[step][j] = ways_memo[j][0];
